Congress Reaches Out to CJP Amid Internal Disagreement

The Congress party is reportedly changing its stance regarding the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP). Rahul Gandhi has extended an offer for 'high tea' to Abhijeet Dipke, indicating a potential shift in the party's approach towards CJP. However, some factions within the party continue to express doubts about CJP's intentions.
